title: Add behavior to a class
prompt: The `Temp` class stores celsius. Add `double toFahrenheit()` returning c × 9/5 + 32, and `boolean isFreezing()` returning true at or below 0. Use the stored field — do not add parameters.

tests.name: temp behavior
tests.hint: Instance methods read fields directly: celsius * 9 / 5 + 32 (watch int division).
